hero.description: Realistic airport ground control. Manage pushbacks, taxi routes, and runway operations on an authentic ASDE-X style radar display.

features.title: ASDE-X Radar Display
features.desc: Authentic surface movement radar with aircraft data tags, modeled after real ASDE-X systems used at major airports.

features.title: Smart Pathfinding
features.desc: A* routing through complex taxiway networks. Aircraft navigate realistic routes and automatically hold short of runways.

features.title: Real Airport Data
features.desc: Precise layouts from GeoJSON — every taxiway, runway, ramp, and gate based on actual airport geometry.

features.title: 40+ Aircraft Types
features.desc: CRJ7s to 737s — each with unique performance specs, taxi speeds, wingspan categories, and realistic behavior.

features.title: Radio Communications
features.desc: Live text-to-speech pilot readbacks with authentic ATC phraseology. Type commands exactly like a real ground controller.

features.title: Conflict Prevention
features.desc: Runway incursion prevention, automatic hold short sequencing, and ground conflict detection built into the simulation core.

roadmap.label: Automatic Route Assignment
roadmap.desc: Realistic departure routes with SIDs and exit fixes

roadmap.label: Smart Taxiway Pathfinding
roadmap.desc: A* routing through complex taxiway networks with automatic hold short

roadmap.label: Pushback & Runway Operations
roadmap.desc: Full pushback sequencing, runway incursion prevention, and crossing commands

roadmap.label: Radio Communications (TTS)
roadmap.desc: Text-to-speech pilot readbacks with authentic phraseology and radio static

roadmap.label: Arrival Operations
roadmap.desc: Landing clearances, approach management, gate assignment — in progress

roadmap.label: Live Weather System
roadmap.desc: Dynamic METAR integration and real-time weather conditions

roadmap.label: More Airports
roadmap.desc: Additional airports with detailed ground layouts and tailored scenarios

blocks.text: Launch GroundStop and a scenario loads automatically. Aircraft spawn at gates and request clearances — your job is to issue them and keep traffic moving safely.

1.  Aircraft requests pushback (automatic)
2.  100 pa           — pushback approved
3.  Aircraft pushes back ~8s, then holds
4.  100 r20ua        — taxi to runway 20 via Uniform, Alpha
5.  100 ct           — contact tower when ready
Use the flight number only — 100 not ENY3639. The yellow number appears above each aircraft on the radar.
Press the semicolon key ; to open the command bar. Format is always [number] [command]. Press Enter to send, Escape to cancel.

100 pa
100 r20ua
100 h20

help     show available commands
clear    clear the log
quit     exit

items: Up / Down — navigate command history (last 20 commands)
Left / Right — move cursor within command
Escape — clear and close command bar

blocks.text: Clears an aircraft to push back from its gate. Aircraft must be in PARKED state.
100 pa
The aircraft backs away from the gate over ~8 seconds, then stops in HOLDING state and waits for a taxi clearance.
Only works on PARKED aircraft. Any other state returns unable.
Taxi clearance to a runway via specified taxiways. Aircraft must be in HOLDING state.

100 r20ua     runway 20 via Uniform, Alpha
100 r02abc    runway 02 via Alpha, Bravo, Charlie
One letter per taxiway — they are converted to phonetics in the pilot readback.
Clears an arrival aircraft to taxi to its parking gate via specified taxiways.

100 rp        taxi to parking (auto-route)
100 rpau      taxi to parking via Alpha, Uniform
Stops the aircraft before a runway hold short bar. Used to prevent runway incursions.
Clears an aircraft to cross a runway.
Verify no landing traffic first — the sim does not auto-block crossings for arrivals.
Chain multiple commands in a single input. The aircraft receives a single readback for all of them.

100 pa ex20        pushback + expect runway 20
100 cr20 r14fg     cross runway 20, then taxi to 14 via F, G

rows: At gate, no movement. Waiting for pushback clearance.
Moving backwards from gate at ~2 kts for ~8 seconds.
Stopped, engines running. Waiting for taxi clearance.
Moving on taxiways at up to 25 kts depending on aircraft.
On final approach, descending toward the runway.
Touching down and rolling out on the runway.
Airborne — will be removed from the simulation shortly.

blocks.text:
PARKED → (pa) → PUSHBACK → HOLDING → (r…) → TAXI → (ct) → TAKEOFF → DEPARTED

APPROACH → LANDING → HOLDING → (rp…) → TAXI → PARKED
The display is modeled after ASDE-X, the surface movement radar system at major US airports.

rows: Yellow number above the icon — use this in commands.
Airline + flight number (e.g. ENY3639). Shown in the data tag.
Current aircraft state shown in the data tag.
Click aircraft to toggle data tag visibility.
Line from aircraft to its data tag. Length is adjustable in settings.

blocks.text: Ctrl+Click an aircraft to open its flight plan panel. Right-click to open the aircraft editor.
All clearances appear in the radio log and are spoken via text-to-speech. Pilots respond with realistic readbacks after a short delay.

PILOT  ENY3639, request pushback
GND    ENY3639, push and start approved, face east
PILOT  Push and start, face east, ENY3639
GND    ENY3639, taxi runway 20 via Uniform, Alpha
PILOT  Runway 20 via Uniform Alpha, ENY3639
Enable voice recognition (PTT) to speak commands instead of typing. Default PTT key is Left Shift.

rows: Command history (in bar) or pan camera
PTT — hold to speak command (voice recognition)

blocks.text: Data tag position: press a Numpad direction key (8/6/2/4/9/3/1/7) then click an aircraft to anchor its tag.

items: Issue pushback + expect runway in one command: 100 pa ex20
Tab-complete callsigns — type part of the number and press Tab
Up arrow recalls the last command — useful for repeated clearances
Use 100 h immediately if a conflict develops — hold position is instant
Arrivals use rp (taxi to parking) instead of r (taxi to runway)
Right-click any aircraft to edit its squawk, callsign, or other fields

rows: Use the yellow number above the icon, not the full callsign.
Aircraft must be in PARKED state to accept a pushback clearance.
Aircraft must be in HOLDING state. Wait for pushback to complete.
Check your audio device in Settings. Requires a valid output device.
Try different taxiway letters or check the taxiway labels overlay.
Hold PTT key, speak clearly, release. Check microphone in Settings.
